[[File:Stone Shattered Disk.png|thumb|220x220px|Stone Shattered Disk]]
The '''Shattered Disks''' are Relics awarded for mastering the [[Code of a Hero]] Special Missions.

== Description ==
'' A shattered version of the [[Golden Disk]], a relic that is said to hold the key to the conquest of the whole Cybertron. Once desired by both Maximals and Predacons alike, now broken beyond repair. Awarded for worthy performance in Special Missions.''

== Relic Boosts ==
* Stone: +1% Attack and Health in Special Missions.
* Bronze: +2%
* Silver: +3%
* Gold: +4%
